scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run performance:check
